title: Confidence from Earlier BMW Ownership
summary: Reviews mainly describe buyers feeling confident in the car based on prior BMW or earlier-version experience, with a smaller set of fragments that are too ambiguous or combine confidence with limited dealer explanation.

positive.summary: Positive reviews say prior ownership of a BMW or earlier version made buyers expect and recognize the car as a good choice.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention immediate confidence in choosing the car or limited dealer explanation, but the overall sentiment is not clear enough to classify more specifically.

limitations: The cluster mixes two subjects: confidence based on prior familiarity with BMWs and a separate comment about weak dealer explanation.
There are only a few example fragments, so finer-grained conclusions about purchase experience or feature usability are not supported.
One undetermined fragment appears positive in wording but remains classified as undetermined, so the summary follows the provided labels rather than reassigning sentiment.
